subject: Marketplace listing — buyer-journey A/B hero & procurement-ready copy
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: AWS Marketplace Team <aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing — buyer-journey A/B hero & procurement-ready copy

Hi team,

Attached is a refreshed hero copy and two buyer-journey variants we want to test on the AWS Marketplace listing for Acme. Goal is to validate which framing (cost-savings vs. time-to-value) drives more private-offer inquiries from procurement and field conversion.

Asks:
- AWS: can you confirm marketplace constraints around CTAs for private offers vs free trials? We want a primary CTA that surfaces "Request private offer" alongside a secondary "Start trial".
- Kim: please review the legal-safe headline and the pricing footnote we included (attached). Looking for anything that'll block procurement review.
- Jonas: can you sanity-check the entitlement examples in section B (hero_v3)? They're tightly tied to our Dedicated offering.

Notes: the hero variants use slightly different trust signals — Variant A includes SLA bullet ("99.9% inference uptime"), Variant B emphasizes performance math (tokens/sec + cost per 1k tokens). We are also experimenting with a short Copilot snippet we can show under "How it works".

Attachments: marketplace_hero_v3.docx, pricing-footnotes-v1.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior GTM Manager, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---

From: AWS Marketplace Team <aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 13:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — buyer-journey A/B hero & procurement-ready copy

Hi Marissa — thanks for the draft. A few points from Marketplace ops: 

1) CTA rules: Marketplace page can show up to two CTAs. "Request private offer" is fine as a primary CTA for eligible accounts but it must route to a Private Offer flow or contact URI. "Start trial" as a secondary CTA is acceptable if the product has trial entitlements enabled in the listing.

2) SLA language: you cannot use absolute uptime guarantees unless you provide a linked SLA doc in the listing and have a corresponding support/contact method. Suggest softening to "SLA-backed options available" and linking to an SLA PDF.

3) Pricing footnote: include a clear metering description and billing footnote explaining whether charges are metered by token or by instance-hour; procurement will request sample invoices.

We can surface a short code/Copilot snippet in the "How it works" panel (up to ~400 characters) — must be copy-only (no inline keys). Send over the final 400-char snippet for approval.

Happy to jump on a 20-min sync if you want to walk through the private-offer wiring.

— AWS Marketplace Ops

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — buyer-journey A/B hero & procurement-ready copy

Quick internal notes after AWS feedback: 

- Change SLA claim to "SLA-backed options available" and attach an SLA stub we can point to. I uploaded a one-page SLA to the Drive folder (see link).
- Pricing footnote: Jonas, please confirm whether the Acme engagement will be metered per-token or per-dedicated-pool-hour. Procurement will want both an example invoice and the metering description.
- CTA routing: Marissa, make sure the Request Private Offer CTA links to the private-offer contact alias (procurement@acmecorp.com) for this deal — AWS will expect a reachable endpoint that triggers a PO workflow.
- Copilot snippet: tighten to single-voice, avoid mentioning internal model names or precise cost figures. I'll draft a 2-line suggestion and push it to the Drive.

Also flagging a procurement consideration: Acme's procurement asked for data residency confirmation for inference results. We should map that to our Private deployment page copy and add a short sentence in the listing: "Regional deployments available (US/EU) — ask your account team for details."

Kim
Director, Marketplace Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace Team <aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com>

Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — buyer-journey A/B hero & procurement-ready copy

Thanks all — action plan below: 

1) Marissa: update hero copy to Variant A/B with the softened SLA line and 400-char Copilot snippet. Upload v4 to Drive by EOD Thu.
2) Jonas: confirm metering model and sample invoice by EOD Thu (I cc'd procurement@acmecorp.com on this thread so they see the ask).
3) Kim: please upload the 1-page SLA and short regional-deploy blurb to the Drive folder (link above).
4) AWS: once we upload v4, could you review the final snippet and verify CTAs will render as intended? If we need a 20-minute sync, I'm available Friday morning.

I'll follow up with a short checklist once v4 is live.

Cheers,
Marissa
